title: Grim Reaper Violinist
description: A hooded skeletal figure in a dark green cloak and purple beret plays a melting violin that drips white and orange liquid. The surreal scene swirls with vibrant orange, teal, and purple smoke, musical notes, jellyfish, orange butterflies, eyes on tentacles, and a dark castle with a black candle and geometric structure in the background.
